output.answer: Xfinity is owned and operated by Comcast Corporation. Comcast’s latest Form 10-K, filed February 3, 2026, identifies Xfinity as one of the primary brands under which Comcast provides broadband, wireless, video, and voice services. As of November 11, 2026, there is no indication in the reviewed sources that this ownership has changed.
caveats: “Owns” is used here in the ordinary business sense: Xfinity is Comcast’s consumer brand and service business. The reviewed sources do not establish that a single individual personally owns Xfinity; Comcast Corporation is a publicly traded company.

passages.quote: We deliver broadband, wireless, video and voice services primarily under the Xfinity, Comcast Business, Sky and NOW brands
